title: Posting Reminder Video Delivery — noon/evening nudges send actual video files
description: posting-reminder.ts now sends the actual video file via Telegram sendVideo after the text nudge. Operator gets video in Telegram at noon + 18:00, saves to phone, uploads to TikTok. Combined with Sprint 226, all posting touchpoints now deliver videos directly.
